root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: `imageOffsetsZ[old_gid].is_null ()` must be false before `(this + imageOffsetsZ[old_gid]).copy (c->serializer, glyph_data_length)` executes.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: The glyph start offset selected for copy must not be the null offset on any path that reaches the `SBIXStrike::subset()` copy call.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable guard checks only offset order, minimum size, and the upper bound. On the crashing path `imageOffsetsZ[old_gid]` is null, yet control still reaches the copy call; the fix adds this missing null-offset rejection at the guard.

nodes.description: At the byte-copy sink, the copied range end `arrayZ + length` lies beyond `_hb_NullPool + sizeof (_hb_NullPool)`, matching the ASan global-buffer-overflow on the null glyph data copy.

edges.relation: The byte-array base pointer of the glyph selected by `this + imageOffsetsZ[old_gid]` is passed unchanged into `hb_array_t::copy()` as `arrayZ`.
The positive `glyph_data_length` derived from the unchecked offset pair is passed unchanged into `hb_array_t::copy()` as `length`.
